name: AlertBrief: brief alerts before they page

parameters.content:
## AlertBrief
Turns raw alerts into a short brief before they reach the on-call engineer: is it real, what happened, what to check first, what else is firing.

**Try it:** click *Test workflow* with **Try sample storm** selected. 37 synthetic alerts become 2 briefed incidents.

**Use it:** point your monitoring tool at the **Alerts in** webhook. Send one alert, an array, or `{ alerts: [...], history: {...} }`.

**Page with the brief:** open **Send to SIGNL4**, replace `YOUR_TEAM_SECRET`, and enable the node.

Nothing is configured per customer. Every name and number in a brief is checked against the alerts before it is sent.

nodes.name: Send to SIGNL4
nodes.notes: Posts each brief to your SIGNL4 team webhook. Uses the HTTP node so every X-S4 field (ExternalID for dedup, Service, Status) is passed through as-is.
